transaction.capture: DIPLO4 captures two equal complete envelopes; six special rows additionally require equal DIPLO5 typed sources
transaction.identity: actor and recipient are resolved by low-24-bit slot and complete signed generation-bearing CharacterID before reconstruction
transaction.reconstruction: five ordinary rows use the exact two-role constructor; six typed rows use a definition-specific materializer supplied by the later private glue owner
transaction.fresh_validation: the rebuilt context is refreshed, finalized, identity-checked and passed through complete Can Send immediately before command construction
transaction.typed_recheck: each rebuilt special context and the command's embedded context are re-read through DIPLO5 and must reproduce the captured typed source exactly
transaction.command: the exact constructor must return caller storage with both frozen vtables and an identity-equivalent embedded 0x338 context
transaction.ownership: the original context and command-embedded context are destroyed exactly once; partially constructed contexts are also cleaned when their definition pointer proves ownership
transaction.ack: SubmitCommand true is only a synchronous queue ACK and remains submitted_verification_pending until DIPLO4's later interaction-specific receipt
